abstract: OBJECTIVE: To assess the prevalence of fertility or infertility in men before and after treatment for unilateral testicular cancer. The results were compared with the lifetime prevalence of infertility in the general population (20%-28%). DESIGN: Survey. SETTINGS: University referral center for testicular cancer. PATIENT(S): Two hundred twenty-six patients treated for testicular cancer. INTERVENTION(S): Questionnaire on fertility and fertility-related factors before and after treatment of disease. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURE(S): Prevalence of fertility before and after treatment for testicular cancer. RESULT(S): Before the cancer was diagnosed, 79 (66%) of 120 couples who attempted to conceive succeeded within 1 year. After treatment, 38 (43%) of 88 couples conceived within 1 year. Seven couples used cryopreserved sperm to conceive a child after treatment. The different treatment modalities did not significantly influence the outcome of patients' wish for children. Congenital malformations were recorded in approximately 4% of the children born before or after treatment. CONCLUSION(S): Although the majority of the patients with testicular cancer have a fulfilled wish with regard to children, it seems to be more difficult to father a child after treatment compared with the case in the general population. Because it is not possible to predict which patient will have fertility problems after treatment, cryopreservation should be offered to every testicular cancer patient. An increased risk for congenital malformations was not observed.
abstract_ja:
目的：精巣がんの片側治療を受けた男性の、治療前後の妊孕性または不妊の頻度を評価すること。一般集団の生涯不妊有病率（20〜28%）と比較した。
 デザイン：調査研究
設定：精巣がんの大学病院紹介センター
対象：精巣がんの治療を受けた226例
介入：治療前後の妊孕性と関連因子に関する質問票
主要評価項目：精巣がんの治療前後の妊孕性の頻度
結果：がん診断前に妊娠を希望した120組のうち79組（66%）が1年以内に妊娠した。治療後は88組のうち38組（43%）が1年以内に妊娠した。7組が治療後に凍結保存精子を用いて子どもをもうけた。治療法の違いは子どもを持つ希望の結果に有意な影響を与えなかった。治療前後に生まれた子どもの約4%に先天奇形が認められた。
結論：精巣がん患者の大多数は子どもを持つという希望を叶えているが、一般集団と比べて治療後に父親になることは難しいようである。治療後に妊孕性問題が生じる患者を予測できないため、すべての精巣がん患者に凍結保存を提供すべきである。先天奇形のリスク増加は認められなかった。
